decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this bleaching tray blank line appears to have shown enough fit with the firm's core dental lab consumables business that the low-cost option is worth continuing rather than abandoning.

The PETG thermoforming blank remains closely aligned with the firm's established materials and workflow portfolio, so continued market presence would make withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

This intraoral contrast spray is somewhat more specialized, but its link to digital and clinical workflows still supports keeping it on the market while it complements the firm's broader solution offering.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are a narrower adjacent niche, yet they continue to leverage the firm's custom manufacturing capabilities enough that management would likely retain the line rather than exit now.
